text:
Anna: Heads up — observed tail latency spikes from our API gateway when streaming long-lived chat connections. Most clients open a streaming POST and leave idle for ~40s between user tokens. When they resume, we see ~500ms extra stalls while gateway tears down/re-establishes upstream. Any suggestions? [details in telemetry logs].

Josh: are these HTTP/1.1 chunked or HTTP/2 bidi? :thinking: 

Anna: HTTP/2 from the browser via our edge (Cloud LB -> Envoy). The edge does TCP keepalive but envoy upstreams to runtime with short idle timeouts (30s).

Mira: hmm — sounds like upstream idle-connection reuse fails and we create a new connection with warmup + jitted kernels. Backpressure + warmup tradeoffs here.

Carl: Two axes: 1) keepidle longer for streaming endpoints, 2) proactively warm a pool of "hot" connections pinned to the model instance. Both cost memory/GPU.

Anna: agreed. also worried about retries — currently gateway retries idempotent POSTs after 5s. That's dangerous for streaming. We should not retry streaming bodies.

Josh: +1. Proposal: mark routes with "no-retry" and route-level streaming hint. Envoy config snippet:
```
route: {
  name: "streaming-chat",
  retry_policy: { retry_on: "5xx","num_retries":0 },
  request_headers_to_add: [{key:"x-redwood-streaming", value:"1"}]
}
```

Mira: love the header hint. Also consider a short HTTP/2 flow-control window tweak and explicit application-level keepalive pings (we already have ping frames). Could also add a 60s upstream idle timeout for these routes.

Anna: what about backpressure — some clients send bursts and we want to shed load gracefully. Options: 429 early, dynamic throttle token-bucket, or per-client queue limiting.

Carl: Implement token-bucket at gateway per API key + route. If bucket empty, reply 429 with Retry-After and a diagnostic header `x-rw-backpressure: token-exhausted`. That keeps semantics clear.

deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-03-streaming-edge-backpressure — pls review :eyes:

Anna: Next steps: Josh to prototype envoy route header + no-retry flag, Mira to test idle timeout changes and pings, Carl to spec token-bucket + header. I'll collect perf runs and update the RFC. Target end of week for a minimal config rollout.

Josh: I'll drop a short PR with envoy config and a small integ test. ping me @Anna if I need access.

Mira: I'll instrument tail-latency histogram and attach logs.

Carl: I'll write the failure-mode docs for 429 and include sample client handling snippet:
```
if (resp.status == 429) {
  wait(parseInt(resp.headers['retry-after'])*1000)
  retry()
}
```

Anna: perfect. Thanks all :rocket:
